statement: Birch Creek is in Dromana VIC.
note: The 2026-09-14 Red Hill claim was disputed because the operator site published no street address and a conflicting postcode. On 2026-10-01 the host-authored Riparide listing for The June identified Dromana and described the two adjoining Birch Creek cottages. The venue record now gives only that supported locality; the street address and exact coordinates remain unverified. The original negative evidence is retained and superseded. See ops/reports/claims/2026-09-14-pilot-address.md for the original pilot.
